reference_sql:
WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend in 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.spend_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend in 2025
  SELECT channel_name, campaign_id, clicks,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name ORDER BY clicks DESC, campaign_id) AS rn
  FROM campaign_clicks
)
SELECT channel_name, campaign_id, clicks
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3

FROM (

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ch.channel_name ORDER BY SUM(a.clicks) DESC, c.campaign_id) AS rn
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.spend_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id

WHERE t.rn <= 3

WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend in 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.spend_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, c.campaign_id
)
SELECT cc.channel_name, cc.campaign_id, cc.clicks
FROM campaign_clicks cc
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_clicks cc2
       WHERE cc2.channel_name = cc.channel_name
         AND (cc2.clicks > cc.clicks OR (cc2.clicks = cc.clicks AND cc2.campaign_id < cc.campaign_id))) < 3

SELECT cc.channel_name, cc.campaign_id, cc.clicks
FROM campaign_clicks cc
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_clicks cc2
       WHERE cc2.channel_name = cc.channel_name
         AND (cc2.clicks > cc.clicks OR (cc2.clicks = cc.clicks AND cc2.campaign_id < cc.campaign_id))) < 3
other_way.tradeoff: Counting the campaigns ahead of each one keeps the same 3 without a window, but it reads the step again for every campaign.

r AS (SELECT channel_name, campaign_id, clicks, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name ORDER BY clicks DESC, campaign_id) AS rn FROM p)
SELECT channel_name, campaign_id, clicks FROM r WHERE rn <= 3
